basic_details.job_title: IIT Mandi Project Associate Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Mandi (IIT Mandi) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 1 Project Associate – I (JRF) Posts. This recruitment drive offers a great opportunity for candidates looking for government jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can apply by sending their resume and documents to the official email address. The email application must be submitted on or before 03-08-2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well before the deadline. In this article, you will find complete details about Project Associate – I (JRF) Recruitment 2026, inc

age_limit.details: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.

Tech. / B.E. / M.Sc. / M.Tech. in Mathematics / Mechanical Engineering / Chemical Engineering (or equivalent) with 60% aggregate marks / 6.0 CGPA, CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS) / GATE / National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions
qualification.details: Project Associate – I (JRF): B. Tech. / B.E. / M.Sc. / M.Tech. in Mathematics / Mechanical Engineering / Chemical Engineering (or equivalent) with 60% aggregate marks / 6.0 CGPA (or equivalent). AND Qualified in at least one of the following: CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS) / GATE / National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions.

salary_details.details: Rs 37,000 p.m. plus HRA as applicable

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Mandi Project Associate – I (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Mandi Project Associate – I (JRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 03 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate – I (JRF) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B. Tech. / B.E. / M.Sc. / M.Tech. in Mathematics / Mechanical Engineering / Chemical Engineering (or equivalent) with 60% aggregate marks / 6.0 CGPA, and must have qualified in CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS) / GATE / National Level examinations.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate – I (JRF) position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate – I (JRF) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate – I (JRF) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month, plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate – I (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Mandi located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Mandi is located in Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, with the pincode 175075.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for this Project Associate – I (JRF) position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can download it from there.
